rows.text: when `rcx` is non-null, replaces bits 16-18 of dword `rcx+0x44` with `dx AND 7` and reads them back; with bit 18 set it stores 0xF9 to byte `+0xAD` when bit 17 is set and 0xF9 to byte `+0xAC` when bit 16 is set, leaving each byte unchanged otherwise; with bit 18 clear it stores 0xF9 (bit 17 set) or 6 (clear) to byte `+0xAD` and 0xF9 (bit 16 set) or 6 (clear) to byte `+0xAC`; a null `rcx` returns at once

with `w` = word `02F9736A`, `v` = word `02F9736C` and `b` = signed byte `rcx+0xB48`, tests `w` in turn against word `01E0C2A4` (0x4000), bit 15, mask 0xA0, word `01E0C2A0` (0x2000), 0x400 and 0x800 for the codes 3, 8, 6, 2, 4, 5: on a match it returns the code when qword `rcx+0xB20` is null or `[rcx+0xB20](qword rcx+0xB30, code, b, b)` is non-zero, and on a zero result returns 0 for code 3 but goes on to the next test for the others; past the tests `x`, `y` = bit 6 minus bit 4 of `w`, `v`, and when `e` = `001E0A10()` is non-zero `y` -= `e` and `x` becomes 0 if `001E0E30()` (called either way) is non-zero, else `x` -= `e`; `n` = `002975B0(rcx, b, x, y)`; it returns 0 when `x` and `y` are both 0; when `n` equals `b` it returns 7 if `0029B790(rcx, 7, n)` is non-zero, else 0; otherwise it returns 0 when `0029B790(rcx, 1, n)` is zero, and else ANDs word `+0x318` of 0x160-byte entry `b` with 0xFFFB, ORs 4 into that word of entry `n`, stores `n` to byte `rcx+0xB48` and returns 1

with `w` = `rcx+0x180`, returns 0 when `00273A20(w)` is non-zero; otherwise calls `00245000(w, 0xC0, 005C5230, 0)`, `002974E0(rcx, rcx+0x218)`, `002475D0(w, 0)`, `00247930(w, 9)`, `00247570(w, 002735E0(0))`, `00244960(rcx, w)` and `00246AC0(w)`, ORs 0x80 into word `rcx+0x318+0x160*i` for `i` below unsigned byte `rcx+0xB42`, and returns 1

with `w` = `rcx+0xC0`, returns 0 when `00273A20(w)` is non-zero; otherwise calls `00245000(w, 0xC0, 005C5230, 0)`, `002974E0(rcx, rcx+0x158)`, `002475D0(w, 0)`, `00247930(w, 9)`, `00247570(w, 002735E0(0))`, `00244960(rcx, w)` and `00246AC0(w)`, calls `00247930(rcx+0x7C0+0xD8*i, 0xB)` for `i` below unsigned byte `rcx+0xB42`, and returns 1
